text:
leo_sales: Quick ask — OrionBio (seed, bioinformatics pipelines) requesting an extended trial to finish a 10-week POC. Asking for 30k credits and 120 days. Current default is $5k/30d. They insist on EU-only hosting and will run heavy tokenization jobs.

jon_dealdesk: Need baseline numbers before I can approve. What are expected peak tokens/day, and is there a committed conversion if POC succeeds? Also any red flags on security?

tara_se: For model guidance: if they do heavy tokenization + alignment tests, expect 800k-1.5M tokens/day while tuning. Could push them to a 13B open model with caching to reduce cost.

leo_sales: Sales expects a $12k/mo pilot conversion for 6 months (~$72k ARR) if POC passes. They're VC-backed and want quick turn. Security constraints: EU control plane and data residency in eu-west-1. No PHI but sensitive bio telemetry.

security_bot: System: automated scan flagged "sensitive-analysis" category; manual security review required for deidentified biomedical telemetry.

jon_dealdesk: Ok. Two options: (A) Full exception: 30k credits / 120d if we get signed pilot SOW committing to $12k/mo for 6 months before credits are used; (B) Partial: 15k credits / 60d with no commit. Which route sales prefers?

leo_sales: We want (A). AE confident on commitment. Can we make it conditional on signed SOW + security signoff? Need credits active before their exec demo next Thursday.

nina_legal: If we're tying credits to a commit, legal needs clear language in the SOW about credit clawback or invoicing after consumption. Also require DPA; compliance review may need an addendum for bioscience data handling.

sam_ops: Ops note: any credit >$10k requires a billing tag and a quota cap to prevent runaway usage. We can set a hard spend ceiling and region-scoped grant.

jon_dealdesk: Draft conditional approval: grant 30,000 trial credits scoped to eu-west-1, expiry 2025-03-01 (120 days), conditions: 1) countersigned pilot SOW or MSA with $12k/mo commit for 6 months before drawdown; 2) security signoff confirming no re-identification risk; 3) usage tagged with "orion-poc-2025"; 4) ops sets quota cap at $30k. Objections?

security_bot: System: Adding manual reviewer @rahul_security.

rahul_security: I'll do the questionnaire review; if they use hosted eu-west with encryption at rest and strict IAM roles, should be OK. We might require contract language limiting model outputs re: genotype inference.

leo_sales: I'll push AE to get SOW signed today and ping customer to accept DPA. Demo is Wednesday.

nina_legal: Once SOW sent, include clauses: credit application conditions, revocation on misuse, and data handling addendum. Legal will prioritize review.

sam_ops: After countersign, ops will apply credits, set region restriction, and enforce quota. We also schedule an alert when usage hits 70% of credit cap.

jon_dealdesk: I'm ok to sign off contingent on SOW + security + legal. Marking as high-priority exception.

security_bot: System: grant-job queued. Job ID: grant-1936123456-A. Status: pending docs.

leo_sales: SOW uploaded to drive and link shared in DM to @jon_dealdesk. Customer accepted DPA via e-sign.

nina_legal: Received SOW, reviewing. Expect countersign this afternoon.

sam_ops: Legal countersigned — ops executing grant.

security_bot: System: security signoff complete. No high-risk flags; recommend monitoring for sensitive inference patterns.

sam_ops: Grant executed. Credits applied: 30000. Expiry: 2025-03-01. Billing tag: orion-poc-2025. Quota cap applied, region eu-west-1 enforced, usage alert set at 70%.

leo_sales: Great — demo confirmed. Thanks everyone. I'll follow up with a short win note after pilot. :party_popper:

jon_dealdesk: Thread closed. One-off exception granted with conditions. Please file final outcomes after pilot completes.
